title: Point Cloud Viewer
text: Visualize streaming point cloud data sequence, 3 inputs, no direct feedthrough; {Open at Start of Simulation} sets the open Point Cloud Viewer window at start, {Location Port} enables point location as input, {Location and Color Port} enables point location and color as input, {Location and Intensity Port} enables point location and intensity, {Display the full path} displays full path of source data in title, {Bring All Point Cloud Viewer Windows Forward} sets the bring all Point Cloud Viewer windows to front, {Simulation Toolbar} shows simulation toolbar, {Status Bar} shows status bar, {Highlight Simulink Block} sets the highlight Point Cloud Viewer block, {Run} sets the view entire point cloud sequence, {Continue}, {Stop} and {Drop Frames to Improve Performance} sets the reduce frame rate of input point cloud. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Location
ports.summary: Positions of points in 3-D coordinate space matrix | array
